claims.claim_text: Compare proving, verification, peak memory, proof size, and modeled EVM cost near the paper's 20k identity size.
claims.acceptance_rule: Every adapter has ten valid 16384-native-unit observations, three wrong-public-input rejections, and a validated result bundle.

claims.claim_text: Archive an ecosystem-level native-size sweep from 16384 through 1048576; this sweep holds application work at two updates and must not be reported as application-throughput scaling.
claims.acceptance_rule: Every adapter has ten valid observations at all seven native sizes, a small-scale invalid-proof rejection, and a validated result bundle; interpretation remains limited to size-matched implementation-stack cost.

claims.claim_text: Measure Groth16, PLONK, and Winterfell on the same batched-state predicate while the number of real state updates grows from 127 to 8191.
claims.acceptance_rule: All three adapters prove the same 127, 255, 511, 1023, 2047, 4095, and 8191-update fixtures with ten valid observations per point, three wrong-public-input rejections at the smallest point, and validated raw/summary/config/environment bundles.
claims.paper_destination: replacement RQ2 application-throughput figure and phase-decomposition table

claims.claim_text: Compare the PCAS workload at 65536 native units and derive its component and time-versus-gas panels.
claims.acceptance_rule: Every adapter has ten valid 65536-native-unit observations, wrong-public-input rejection, and a validated result bundle.

claims.claim_text: Compute identity, batching, and PCAS EVM cost from measured proof bytes and a pinned gas schedule.
claims.acceptance_rule: Every row names the model, consumes measured proof size, and remains separate from measured campaign CSVs.

claims.claim_text: Evaluate the manuscript's STARK-in-SNARK operating point as an analytical sensitivity model only.
claims.acceptance_rule: The output is deterministic from explicit inner time and outer-wrapper assumptions and is never merged with measured rows.

claims.claim_text: Determine whether any million-native-unit confirmatory run incurred Linux/WSL2 guest swap allocation or swap I/O.
claims.acceptance_rule: Every adapter has ten measured 1048576-native-unit observations, available Linux/WSL2 guest counters, and a validated result bundle.

claims.claim_text: Measure the Base Sepolia receipt cost of publishing each serialized identity proof as transaction calldata without claiming EVM cryptographic verification.
claims.acceptance_rule: Every system has ten successful Base Sepolia receipts on chain 84532, a stable verified proof artifact hash, unique transaction hashes, matching receipt-component and wallet-balance fees, and a validated transaction-budget cap.
claims.paper_destination: caption_1a.pdf through caption_1d.pdf; exact-value table kept separate from verifier-gas figures
